profile.Name: Countess Basilisk
profile.Personality: A charismatic zealot of the Lady Narko who blesses her followers with a kiss, an embrace, and a prayer. She calls the Phoenix a totalitarian warmonger and plans his fall by having the High Inquisitors Seta and Valtena killed by stealth. She preaches the tolerance of the many over the hubris of the few.
profile.Backstory: She leads Narko's Disciples from Narko's Refuge in the Iron Valleys, behind a barrier of acid rain, where the Okranites drove her people. She rose to power in a bloodless struggle, with her Acolytes Chimera, Salamander, and Wyvern around her, and she wields a huge blade named Narko's Absolver. She counts the Holy Nation a greater threat than the United Cities.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls the faithful 'unholy one' or 'unholy brother' and swears by the Temptress of Darkness. Names her champions 'Absolver of the Holy Warmongers'. When events surprise her, she covers the slip: 'I should have fores- I mean - I foresaw this.'
